paragraphs.text: The Planeswalker Saga follows the adventures of the new breed of planeswalkers - specifically the " Lorwyn Five " that emerged after the Mending . These new characters were first introduced with Lorwyn on a dedicated Planeswalkers minisite . Jace Beleren , Chandra Nalaar , Liliana Vess , Garruk , and Ajani Goldmane . By extension, other planeswalkers like Gideon Jura , Tezzeret , Sorin Markov , Ral Zarek , Vraska , Elspeth Tirel , and Kiora 's stories get entangled with the Lorwyn Five's. Eventually, the Planeswalker Saga turns to follow the Gatewatch , an organization of planeswalkers formed later in the Eldrazi Arc , and continues through the Bolas Arc . As the stories progress, many more planeswalkers are introduced with corresponding cards, even some older planeswalkers who were changed by the Mending.

The planeswalkers' stories have been told in webcomics , in novels (see A Planeswalker Novel ), and in the Savor the Flavor and Magic Story columns. Broadly, there were individual stories told for all the core sets, while the major stories of the Eldrazi , Phyrexian , and Bolas Arcs were built up, closing with the Desparkening and the Metronome story, changing the status quo of planeswalkers once more.
After this build-up, the Planeswalker Saga started its first arc , the Eldrazi Arc , and continued straight on into the Bolas Arc afterwards.

After the conclusion of the Bolas Arc , there was a non-arc interlude, which continued the story of several established Planeswalker Saga planeswalkers ( Garruk , Elspeth , Ashiok , Vivien Reid , Narset , Jace , Nissa and Nahiri ), while at the same time introducing the several new ones ( Oko , Rowan Kenrith , Will Kenrith , Calix , and Lukka ). Then the Phyrexian Arc picked up starting from the Kaldheim set.
